title: New results on alkali-ion-modified ZIF glasses
text: Recent work reports alkali-ion modification as a route to tune zeolitic imidazolate framework glasses.

title: Hybrid glass and membrane processing directions expand
text: Current projects connect meltable and directly synthesised frameworks with thin-film processing, nanofiltration, and proton-transport screening.

title: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship at KU Leuven
text: The MOPOWER project develops MOF-derived proton-conducting hybrid glasses for energy technologies.

title: MOF glass papers published across Nature Communications, JACS, Angewandte Chemie, and Chemistry of Materials
text: Recent publications cover porous MOF liquids and glasses, metal-carboxylate framework glasses, mechanochemical glass formation, and defect identification.
